title: The easy merge

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: The schedule is ready! Let's bring it into `main`.

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: To merge a branch, first you move to the receiving branch. Type `git switch main`.

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: Then use `git merge schedule` to bring those commits in.

hints: Which branch should you be on to receive the merge?
Switch to main first. Then merge brings another branch into yours.
Type `git switch main` then `git merge schedule`.

predict.question: You are on main. What will the graph look like after `git merge schedule`?

choices.text: main moves forward to the schedule commit
A new merge commit is created

predict.explanation: Because main had no new commits, git just slides the main label forward to catch up. That is a fast-forward.

recap: `git merge <branch>` brings commits from that branch into your current branch.

cheatSheet.summary: Merge another branch into your current one
